text: This report requests that City Council deny the request for a permit to remove one privately owned tree located on the boundary line between the properties of 122 Pearson Avenue and 120 Pearson Avenue. The application indicates the reason for removal is to address safety concerns from falling deadwood and future potential damage to the fence and homes. The subject tree is a tulip tree (Liriodendron tulipifera), measuring 51 cm in diameter. The Tree By-laws do not support the removal of this tree as it is healthy and maintainable.

City Council on October 1 and 4, 2021, adopted the following: 1. City Council deny the request for a permit to remove one privately owned tree located on the boundary line between the properties of 122 Pearson Avenue and 120 Pearson Avenue.
